messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: High error spike in eu-central gateway - 502/504 + timeouts across /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. ErrorRate_eu-central > 12% over 5m. Paging @maria-sre for oncall. :rotating_light:

maria-sre: oncall here, seeing it. Confirming impact: internal dashboard shows gateway.pending queue > 1200 and avg latency -> 1.8s. Which traffic is primary? embeddings or streaming gen?

kevin-obs: both, but embeddings is heavier on eu-central workers atm. KV cache hit ratio dropped from 82% -> 29%  at time of spike.

ashok-runtime: I see a pattern: several eu-central egress nodes reporting `socket hang up` and `upstream reset` to the model pool. Could be transient network blips to the model host group or overloaded worker processes.

jon-platform: we've got a canary cluster in eu-central that's also showing degraded p95. I'm going to check routing rules - maybe a recent rollout bumped concurrency defaults. @li-deploy any recent changes pushed to routing?

li-deploy: deploy-bot shows a config push at 2384121200 that adjusted `max_concurrency` for model pool `rwd-ggml-v2` from 32 -> 48 in eu-central. Rolling back now if we agree.

maria-sre: rollback that change. It may be oversubscribing worker threads causing connection churn. Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback-config rwd-ggml-v2 --region eu-central --to 2384121199`

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Rolling back config...

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 2384123520. New effective `max_concurrency` is 32.

ashok-runtime: thanks. I'm toggling the `egress_eu_circuit` circuit breaker to FORCE_OPEN for the most flappy upstream set to stop thrashing. Command:
```
rtctl cb set egress_eu_circuit FORCE_OPEN --region eu-central
```
This will route traffic to backup pool while we investigate.

jon-platform: pre-authorized. Doing traffic-steer to us-west backup pool (gradual 10% steps) to avoid customer-visible cold starts. Using `trafficctl steer --from eu-central --to us-west --percent 10`

maria-sre: start paging customers via status page note: set `service affected: inference eu-central` and mark as partial degradation. @eva-cs start collecting impacted orgs from logs.

eva-cs: collecting now. Early hits: three enterprise tenants with high-traffic embeddings pipelines showing repeated 502s. Reached out to account owners with heads up.

kevin-obs: metrics after initial mitigations: ErrorRate_eu-central 5m -> dropped to 7.2%. gateway.pending back down to 420. KV cache still low 35% but trending up slowly.

maria-sre: good. Next steps: keep circuit breaker open, continue incremental traffic steer to us-west until error rate < 1%. Also start draining the most recent eu-central worker boxes that saw socket errors so they restart cleanly. @ashok-runtime can you trigger graceful drain for nodes with high reset counts?

ashok-runtime: running drain on node list (example):
```
shardctl drain --node eu-central-rt-342 --grace 60s
shardctl drain --node eu-central-rt-347 --grace 60s
```
I've queued 6 nodes. They will detach from LB and restart.

li-deploy: adding temporary rate-limit knob at the gateway for embeddings route to reduce burst amplification: `gatewayctl set-rate-limit /v1/embeddings 120rps --region eu-central`

maria-sre: set to 120rps. Also enabling degraded mode fallback for streaming generate -> non-streaming buffered path for eu-central to reduce open connections. This will add latency but reduce socket churn.

jon-platform: traffic steer is at 60% to us-west now. Observability: p95 latency on eu-central stable at 420ms, error rate 2.1% (5m).

kevin-obs: adding note: we observed a correlated spike in `network.tcp_retransmits` on three eu-central hosts starting 2384123400. That smells like a noisy NIC or fabric issue between eu-central availability zones. Will loop in infra network team if residuals persist.

maria-sre: agreed. If error rate doesn't go <1% after drains and steer, escalate to networking. For now, continue monitor and keep customers updated. ETA next status update in 15m.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Partial service degradation in eu-central. Mitigations in progress: rollback config, circuit breaker open, traffic-steer to us-west, drains initiated, temporary rate limits applied.

ashok-runtime: drains finished, 6 nodes restarted with no immediate socket errors on restart. KV cache warmed slowly, hit ratio -> 56%.

kevin-obs: ErrorRate_eu-central (5m) = 0.8%, gateway.pending = 60, p95 = 210ms. Good.

maria-sre: excellent. Proceed to stepdown: gradually close circuit breaker and pull traffic back to eu-central in 10% increments to validate stability. If any increase >1% error rate, rollback to full steer and reopen CB.

jon-platform: steering back 20% to eu-central now.

li-deploy: removing temporary rate-limit from embeddings route. `gatewayctl delete-rate-limit /v1/embeddings --region eu-central`

eva-cs: notifying impacted customers that the issue appears mitigated; follow-up message will include root-cause timeline and postmortem ETA.

maria-sre: marking incident as RESOLVING for now. Will keep monitoring for 1h before close. Great work everyone. :clap:
